title: Claude Code: observed JSONL record
description: Applies to one decoded Claude session record; metadata variants may omit message/uuid/timestamp. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

type.description: Record type: conversation, summary, queue-operation, attachment, file-history-snapshot, and others.

anyOf.description: Parent message/record UUID; not the session ID.

sessionId.description: Native session identity used by the current Claude reader.

session_id.description: Compatibility spelling accepted by the user's metadata reader.

sessionID.description: Additional compatibility spelling accepted by the user's metadata reader.

timestamp.description: Recorded timestamp string; preserve original representation, parse only when valid.

cwd.description: Recorded working directory. Stronger identity evidence than reverse-decoding a slug.

gitBranch.description: Recorded branch name, not proof of current checkout state.

model.description: Optional top-level model label; message.model can also carry it.

isCompactSummary.description: Marks a compaction-summary carrier, not an ordinary human message.

summary.description: Provider-supplied session summary on summary records.

leafUuid.description: Summary-associated leaf message UUID when recorded, read by ccrider.

version.description: Recorded client version string when supplied.

userType.description: Recorded user-type metadata; do not infer identity beyond source.

role.description: Provider role. A user-role tool_result carrier is not necessarily human input.

type.description: Content-block discriminator; unknown variants must remain reachable.

text.description: Text content when this block is textual.

thinking.description: Recorded thinking text, when present; not a guarantee of all model reasoning.

name.description: Exact tool name, including namespace when encoded here.

input.description: Native tool input, commonly an object; preserve original value.

tool_use_id.description: Identifier linking a result block to a tool_use block.

content.description: Result payload, either string, nested blocks, or another source-specific value.

is_error.description: Provider-recorded tool-result error flag; absence is unknown, not success.

content.description: Native content carrier; inspect block discriminators before flattening.

model.description: Model recorded on the assistant message.

input_tokens.description: Recorded input token count; aggregation must respect provider usage semantics.

usage.description: Assistant usage fields consumed by continues.

items.description: Opaque provider-specific payload. Preserve it; the inspected sources do not establish its complete schema.

questions.description: Original ask-user questions or source-specific tool result metadata.

answers.description: Ask-user answers keyed by full question text; values may be strings or arrays.

annotations.description: Question-keyed operator annotations; nested notes may contain human-authored text.

agentId.description: Subagent identity used by the Claude sidecar extraction path.

toolUseResult.description: Top-level result metadata; do not discard merely because it lies outside message.content.

operation.description: Queue operation, e.g. enqueue or remove.

content.description: Queued prompt text on queue-operation records.

snapshot.description: File-history snapshot metadata and backup references; not a verified Git diff.
